digest.component_or_area: graph loader / BFS traversal and ticket unblock detection
propositions: The target-side _is_at_level guard in _same_level_neighbors is not exercised by existing cycle tests because all use uniform level; a direct cross-level edge whose far end is the queried source_id will be incorrectly accumulated if the guard is removed.
An epic→task→epic traversal must be refused by graph level checks so that a lower-level hop cannot reconnect two same-level nodes.

When a blocker dir is unreducible and reduce returns None but a tombstone with non-terminal status exists, a status-only stub must be loaded so the blocker reads as non-closed and does not unblock the target.
A present tombstone's status must override the reduced status of a blocker, so an open blocker dir with a deleted tombstone counts as closed and unblocks the target.
A malformed unparseable tombstone must degrade to 'deleted' rather than to absent, so an open blocker dir with corrupted tombstone bytes still counts as closed.
